name: cbre-il-toolkit
description: CBRE's Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude — branded decks, account briefings, outreach angles, property longlists, warehouse-network maps, and on-brand writing, plus a UK I&L toolkit.

plugins.name: cbre-il-toolkit
plugins.description: The CBRE Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude. Build polished, on-brand PowerPoint decks, turn a folder of property materials into an interactive longlist dashboard, draft I&L account briefings, surface evidence-backed reasons to reach out to a target company now as a ranked outreach-angles sheet with ready-to-send email hooks, map a company's warehouse and distribution network to an auditable Excel, and keep every word in the CBRE tone of voice.

plugins.name: uk-il-toolkit
plugins.description: The UK Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude. Build a client-ready I&L longlist from a Kato requirement — enriched with rents and specs from the broker emails, ending in a per-property dataset, a clean client Excel and a CBRE-branded HTML dashboard — and download every brochure PDF linked from a longlist spreadsheet as one clean zip, named after each property and validated. Versioned and installed independently of the CBRE I&L Toolkit, so updating one never re-syncs the other.
